name: Hong Lou Meng: Lin Daiyu yu Bei Jing Wang
original_name: 红楼梦：林黛玉与北静王
source: Visual novel adaption of the Qing dynasty novel “Dream of a Red Chamber”, with Bei Jing Wang as the protagonist. Extended version of the previous game, with the main heroines fully voiced and additional CG and endings.
